digest.component_or_area: outbound parent reconciliation (CREATE and ACLI fallback paths)
propositions: When a CREATE emit drops a non-epic parent (8b25 guard), only logger.debug records it; no durable bridge_alerts entry is created, violating the project's own contract that dropped parents must leave operator-visible records
When ACLI attach fallback receives HTTP 400 rejecting a parent, the error is logged and swallowed but record_parent_divergence is never called, leaving no durable outbound-parent-rejected alert

The 8b25 unconditional non-epic parent guard suppresses writes on both Cloud (which 400s them) and Data Center (which silently ignores them), but the doc and code diverge on which behavior justifies the guard for each vendor
Slot 2 (CREATE emit) and Slot 4 (ACLI attach) are the only two remaining surfaces where hierarchy edits drop without durable records; Slots 1 and 3 were already fixed and hold the rule
An UNBOUND parent (not yet synced to the tracker) must remain silent in alerts because it converges on a later pass and alerting would be churn; only BOUND parents that drop should record
